label: Enrich Characters & Locations
description: Reads the imported screenplay's dialogue and action lines, then uses AI to fill in missing character data (description, age, gender, traits, arc, voice, wardrobe, relationships) and location data (description, type, mood, atmosphere). Processes main and supporting characters first, up to a configurable limit.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline ID. Defaults to the current pipeline.

maxCharacters.description: Maximum number of characters to enrich (processes main roles first)

enrichedCharacters.description: Number of characters that were enriched

enrichedLocations.description: Number of locations that were enriched
